description: This is a Java source file defining the RecipeActivity class for an Android application. It manages the display of a recipe including title, summary, ingredients, and steps. It loads recipe data from JSON assets, inflates UI components, and handles menu actions.

classes.name: RecipeActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for displaying a recipe, handling UI updates, and starting the cooking process.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onStart to load the recipe when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, and finds view references.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically starting the cooking process.

methods.name: loadRecipe
methods.description: Loads recipe data from JSON assets and triggers display.

methods.name: displayRecipe
methods.description: Populates UI components with recipe data, inflating steps and images.

methods.name: startCooking
methods.description: Starts the RecipeService to initiate cooking with the current recipe.
